# conversations.Conversation

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A chat conversation of a member: title, summary, pin and archive state; the messages live in agent memory.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `conversations.Conversation` |
| Kind | `entity` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `user` |
| Permission | `core.conversation.read` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `activeRunId` | yes | `none` | Agent run streaming now; null when idle. |  |
| `activeStreamStartedAt` | yes | `none` | When the active run started; stale after 15 minutes. |  |
| `agentId` | yes | `none` | Chat agent that answers. |  |
| `archivedAt` | yes | `none` | When the owner archived it; null when active. |  |
| `createdAt` | yes | `none` | When the conversation started (UTC). |  |
| `deletedAt` | yes | `none` | Soft delete; purged 30 days later. |  |
| `id` | yes | `none` | Firestore automatic id; also the memory thread id. |  |
| `lastMessageAt` | yes | `none` | When the last turn ended (UTC). |  |
| `messageCount` | yes | `none` | Turns sent and answered (approximate). |  |
| `ownerId` | yes | `personal` | Uid of the member who owns the conversation. |  |
| `pinned` | yes | `none` | Pinned conversations are listed first. |  |
| `projectId` | yes | `none` | Project the conversation runs in; null at organization level. |  |
| `searchTokens` | yes | `personal` | Lower-case, accent-folded words of the title and summary, for search. |  |
| `summary` | yes | `personal` | Summary made on request; may mention people. |  |
| `tenantId` | yes | `none` | Owning organization. |  |
| `title` | yes | `personal` | Title; generated after the first turn or set by the owner. |  |
| `titleSource` | yes | `none` | auto until the owner renames it. |  |
| `updatedAt` | yes | `none` | When the metadata last changed (UTC). |  |

## Relations

- `belongs-to` `tenancy.Organization` via `tenantId`
